exposure: Childbirth preparation nursing intervention integrating an Islamic praying (CPNsIIIP) program (childbirth education on positioning, breathing, stroking, and Islamic praying)
outcome: Duration of active phase of labor
Neonatal outcomes (APGAR scale, complication of fetus after birth)
cohort: 83 primiparous Muslim women randomly assigned to an intervention or control group.
finding: The childbirth preparation program significantly shortened the duration of the active phase of labor and improved neonatal outcomes (except for APGAR scores) in primiparous Muslim women.
followup_time: Immediate postnatal (1 and 5 minutes for APGAR scores, and complications after birth)
